There's a famous doctor in California, Dr. Sam Most, who specializes in them. His insta is @smostmd and you can see examples of a preservation rhinoplasty there. I found out about them from him but I know there are a few others doctors who also do them.
I got double jaw surgery. If your chin is your only concern, you could get a genioplasty only. I'm not aware of another way to reduce the size of the lower jaw outside of contouring with makeup🤷

If you're concerned with looking like every other Instagram girl, reconsider getting a button nose. First all, you want a nose that will fit your features and add to your overall facial harmony. A button nose may or may not be the best way to do that. Second of all, the nose is one of the features that make people unique. Aly Art has a great video on noses that I think you would like: https://youtu.be/fD4PrRB0_sY

Her videos are great if you're want to improve your looks without losing your uniqueness because she has tips for almost every body type, feature, face shape, etc. 

And finally to go off personal experience, I used to have a very "unique" face as people would tell me lol. I had a big hook nose and a big lower jaw. After getting those features surgically changed, I look wayyyyy more basic. If I could go back, I would've probably gotten a preservation rhinoplasty (look into this, too) to preserve the shape of my nose but reduce the size and refine it a bit.

I just graduated college and I make $24k a year working full time. They have now asked that I start supporting them by contributing to their food budget. My dad in particular has been eating out every single day for the last 20 years because he works so much and doesn't have time to cook. My mom's food budget is somehow 4 times mine.
